name: Decitabine (MDS, hypomethylating agent)

biomarkers.note: Not biomarker-restricted. Treatment is risk-stratified by IPSS-R: decitabine is a hypomethylating-agent option for higher-risk MDS (IPSS-R Intermediate, High, Very-High) and is also used in lower-risk MDS. Note that a phase III overall survival benefit is reported for azacitidine and not for decitabine. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Myelodysplastic Syndromes v3.2026.

treatmentSetting: risk-stratified by IPSS-R; option for higher-risk MDS, also used in lower-risk MDS

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: MDS risk-stratified by IPSS-R (higher-risk: Intermediate, High, Very-High; lower-risk: Very-Low, Low, Intermediate)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v3.2026, MDS-4 (lower-risk) and MDS-7 (higher-risk); IPSS-R on MDS-B

drugs.name: Decitabine

provenance.locator: Footnotes for MDS-7 (standard monthly dosing of decitabine is 20 mg/m2/day IV x 5 days)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Myelodysplastic Syndromes v3.2026, Footnotes for MDS-7. Decitabine 20 mg/m2/day IV on days 1 to 5 of each 28-day cycle. Hypomethylating agent; response may not be evident before 3 to 4 cycles, so continue until progression if tolerated. Expect myelosuppression.

supportiveCare: Antiemetic prophylaxis for a hypomethylating agent per institutional practice.
Continue treatment for at least 3 to 4 cycles before assessing response; continue until progression if tolerating therapy.
Transfusion support and infection monitoring for treatment-related cytopenias.

monitoring: CBC with differential before each cycle and during cycles (myelosuppression)
bone marrow assessment for response after several cycles

doseModificationRules.text: Delay the next cycle or reduce dose per prescribing information for prolonged severe cytopenias; physician decides.

guideline.locator: Footnotes for MDS-7 (standard monthly dosing of decitabine is 20 mg/m2/day IV x 5 days); MDS-4 (lower-risk) and MDS-7 (higher-risk) treatment pathways; IPSS-R on MDS-B

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for decitabine in MDS, a hypomethylating agent used in risk-stratified (IPSS-R) treatment. Dose grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Myelodysplastic Syndromes v3.2026, Footnotes for MDS-7: decitabine 20 mg/m2/day IV on days 1 to 5 of each 28-day cycle. cycles null because a hypomethylating agent is continued until progression (response may take 3 to 4 cycles).
